usage: kathara list [-h] [-a] [-w] [-n DEVICE_NAME]

Show all running Kathara devices of the current user

options:
  -h, --help            Show a help message and exit.
  -a, --all             Show all running Kathara devices of all users. MUST BE
                        ROOT FOR THIS OPTION.
  -w, -l, --watch, --live
                        Watch mode.
  -n, --name DEVICE_NAME
                        Show only information about a specified device.

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
